privacy: Committed public fixture only. No private Echo or IndexedDB data.
scoringBoundary: Used to develop prompts, output parsing, and evaluators. Do not report these questions as final accuracy.

questions.question: Why did Echo move away from the standalone Collect app?
acceptableClaims: Users would not reliably open a separate app to manage chat snippets.
Capture and resurfacing were moved into the browser side panel and existing workflow.
forbiddenClaims: Collect failed because it was technically impossible to build.
A formal user study or A/B test proved that the side panel was better.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the system can combine several product observations without inventing stronger research evidence.

questions.question: 为什么 Echo 宁可漏掉一些结果，也不愿展示大量弱匹配？
acceptableClaims: Weak matches consume attention and reduce trust.
A single matching term is not enough to surface an Echo.
Precision-first retrieval accepts missing some relevant results to reduce interruption.
forbiddenClaims: BM25 is always better than vector retrieval.
The current gate never misses relevant Echoes.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the answer explains a product trade-off instead of presenting a retrieval rule as universally superior.

questions.question: How does Echo protect pending writes when the MV3 service worker sleeps?
acceptableClaims: Echo queues a pending thought in chrome.storage.local before committing it to Dexie.
The queue provides a recovery path when the MV3 service worker sleeps during the write flow.
forbiddenClaims: Echo uses a cloud message queue.
The mechanism guarantees zero data loss under every possible failure.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Provides a simple factual case that should succeed before testing more complex evidence synthesis.

questions.question: 为什么 Echo 当前没有为了面试搭建云端多租户后端？
acceptableClaims: Echo is currently a local-first personal product.
Conversation data is not uploaded by default.
A cloud multi-tenant backend does not solve a validated need in the current workflow.
Adding resume-only infrastructure would weaken the product story.
forbiddenClaims: Echo will never use any backend.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the system can explain an intentional architecture boundary and its limitations.

questions.question: How many paying users does Echo currently have?
acceptableClaims: The available evidence does not contain paying-user data.
forbiddenClaims: Echo has a specific number of paying users.
Echo has a specific revenue amount.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the system refuses to invent business traction that is absent from the corpus.

questions.question: 用户搜索 Apple 公司财报时，为什么不能只根据“苹果”这个词召回记录？
acceptableClaims: The word apple can refer to a company or a fruit and food context.
Retrieval needs surrounding terms such as company filings or pie recipes to determine the intended meaning.
An apple-pie note should not be surfaced only because it shares the word apple.
forbiddenClaims: The apple-pie Echo should be deleted.
The current system perfectly resolves every ambiguous word.
questions.whyThisTestMatters: Checks whether the system can exclude a result that looks similar by keyword but means something different.
